verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev supports high concurrency (concurrencyLimit, queues) and programmatic listing/filtering of runs (runs.list with status filters) plus per-run cancel/retry via handles, which together enable operating on many items, but there is no direct evidence of a dedicated bulk/batch trigger or bulk-cancel API for acting on many items in one call. missing for 10: explicit batch-trigger endpoint, bulk cancel/retry across multiple runs in a single operation, independent confirmation of large-scale batch usage.
